Swampjaw.find: Summoned anywhere with Fossil Bait (spider eyes, bones and rotten flesh), easiest in a swamp. It will not summon if another boss is near.

attacks.name: Mine drop
attacks.desc: Flies above you and drops three mines that blow up like creepers.

attacks.name: Swoop bite
attacks.desc: Dives down to bite you; hitting it first cancels the bite.

Draugr → Night Shade.find: Old Champion's Remains sleeps in the Old Champion's Graves (find with a Moonstone Compass). When it dies the Frenzied Shade comes out; that second phase is the real kill. Re-fight by using the Draugr sword on an Old Moon Altar.

attacks.name: Shield stance
attacks.desc: Guards behind his shield, bashes and vaults at you; same-weapon spam makes him resist.

attacks.name: Heavy Blow
attacks.desc: Winds back and slams the sword down in an area.

attacks.name: Battle Cry
attacks.desc: Bangs sword on shield to slow and weaken everyone near.

attacks.name: Shade: Moon Wave
attacks.desc: The Shade throws a big moonlight wave.

attacks.name: Shade: Soul Outbreak
attacks.desc: Flies up and crashes down in a soul explosion; splits into copies at half health.

Bellringer.find: Summoned with a Haunted Bell (gold and cobbled deepslate). Floats through walls.

attacks.name: Projectile lines
attacks.desc: Sends waves of projectiles along the ground toward you; they pass through walls.

attacks.name: Falling square
attacks.desc: Forms a square of projectiles above you that drops down.

attacks.name: Bell toll
attacks.desc: Below half health rings its bell to slow everyone, then fires a long barrage.

Frostbitten Golem.find: Sleeps in the Frostbitten Temple in snowy plains, snowy taiga and ice spikes. Craft its locator eye to find it.

attacks.name: Freezing hits
attacks.desc: Its punches freeze and slow you.

attacks.name: Ice spikes
attacks.desc: Raises ice spikes out of the ground under you.

Dune Sentinel.find: Buried in the Ruined Pyramid in deserts. Craft its locator eye to find it.

attacks.name: Sandstone shots
attacks.desc: A living sandstone cannon that keeps you away with ranged shots.

attacks.name: Immovable
attacks.desc: Cannot be knocked back at all.

Overgrown Colossus.find: Hidden in the Mossy Temple in jungles. Craft its locator eye to find it.

attacks.name: Poison blows
attacks.desc: Heavy hits that poison you if you stay in melee.

attacks.name: Mossy Golems
attacks.desc: Calls Mossy Golems to help at half and quarter health.

Skeletosaurus.find: Sleeps in a Skeletosaurus Nest in Nether soul sand valleys. Throw an Eye of Bones to find one.

attacks.name: Tail whip
attacks.desc: Sweeps its tail to launch you; becomes a double whip below half health.

attacks.name: Ground slam
attacks.desc: Shakes the ground with a shockwave.

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.desc: A scary roar that throws you off balance.

attacks.name: Gravity pull
attacks.desc: Later in the fight it pulls you in and can lift you up.

Yeti.find: Skor the Yeti waits in its arena in frozen plains (Bosses'Rise).

attacks.name: Fist swing
attacks.desc: Wide two-fist swing that freezes you.

attacks.name: Leap slam
attacks.desc: Jumps high and crashes down; icicles burst from the ground.

attacks.name: Ice chunks
attacks.desc: After half health throws fast chunks of ice.

attacks.name: Ice Barrage
attacks.desc: Its big finishing attack.

Frostmaw.find: Sleeps rarely in snowy plains and ice spikes, holding an Ice Crystal. Steal the crystal first to make the fight easier.

attacks.name: Swipe
attacks.desc: Swipes in front, sometimes twice; can disable shields.

attacks.name: Ice breath
attacks.desc: Breathes a freezing whirlwind (not if you stole its crystal).

attacks.name: Ice ball
attacks.desc: Shoots a freezing ball when you are far away.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.desc: Below about 60% health stands up and slams the ground; breaks shields.

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.desc: Knocks everyone near away.

Umvuthi.find: Sits on his throne in the Umvuthana Grove in savannas. Wearing an Umvuthana mask keeps him calm.

attacks.name: Sunstrike
attacks.desc: Calls a beam of sunfire down where you are going.

attacks.name: Solar Flare
attacks.desc: Blasts away anyone close to him.

attacks.name: Solar Beam
attacks.desc: Later fires a long tracking sun beam.

attacks.name: Supernova
attacks.desc: Pulls you in, then explodes in fire.

attacks.name: Cranes and followers
attacks.desc: Summons followers; Cranes heal and shield him until killed.

Naga.find: Flies in packs over stony shores. Not a boss bar fight, but tough in groups.

attacks.name: Acid spit
attacks.desc: Spits acid balls that poison.

attacks.name: Swoop
attacks.desc: Dives and spins into you.

attacks.name: Dodge
attacks.desc: Dodges arrows; a hit while it attacks knocks it down.

Dame Fortuna.find: Summoned with a Devil's Ante (gold, netherrack and a diamond).

attacks.name: Card shots
attacks.desc: Throws projectiles straight at you.

attacks.name: Rain from above
attacks.desc: Sends the same projectiles down from above.

attacks.name: Chasing fangs
attacks.desc: Fangs rise from the ground following you.

Dead King.find: Sits on a throne at the end of the Catacombs deep underground (find with a Wayward Compass). Walk up to wake him.

attacks.name: Double swing and slam
attacks.desc: Two quick hits or a heavy slam with a wind-up.

attacks.name: Wither skulls
attacks.desc: Fires volleys of wither skulls.

attacks.name: Raise Dead
attacks.desc: Summons undead minions from the floor.

attacks.name: Vex and Blaze Storm
attacks.desc: In the last phase he flies and adds vexes and fire storms.

Cumulonimbus.find: Cumulonimbus lives in the Cloudy Temple. Craft its locator eye to find it.

attacks.name: Exploding clouds
attacks.desc: Summons big clouds above you that explode.

attacks.name: Block hit
attacks.desc: A blocking hit that puts your shield on cooldown.

attacks.name: Angry phase
attacks.desc: In phase two fights with both arms and calls lightning.

Ancient Guardian.find: Sleeps in the Ancient Stronghold in dark forest and taiga (Eye of Many Ribs). Projectiles do not hurt it.

attacks.name: Anchor combo
attacks.desc: Three wide anchor swings; the last knocks your shield away.

attacks.name: Stun slam
attacks.desc: Warned on screen; stuns you unless you block.

attacks.name: Grab
attacks.desc: Grabs you if you are not blocking and pounds you into the ground.

attacks.name: Leap
attacks.desc: Jumps at you from range.

Netherite Monstrosity.find: Sleeps in the soul fire of the Soul Forge in the Nether; wakes when you come close.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.desc: Slams both fists for a big area hit.

attacks.name: Lava spit
attacks.desc: Spits magma bombs that leave lava.

attacks.name: Charged arm
attacks.desc: Charges at you, breaking blocks and slowing you.

attacks.name: Earth wave
attacks.desc: Throws the ground at you; shields can block it.

attacks.name: Lava heal
attacks.desc: Sucks up lava to heal; enrages near the end and sets you on fire.

Rosalyne.find: Summoned with a Dusk Key (blackstone, amethyst, a diamond and an allium).

attacks.name: Rose Spirits
attacks.desc: Starts sealed in stone with four Rose Spirits; kill them to break her shell. Happens again at half health.

attacks.name: Charging slashes
attacks.desc: Rises, then charges and swings her sword at you.

attacks.name: Frenzy
attacks.desc: In the last phase swings many more times with short pauses.

Luxtructosaurus.find: Sealed inside a volcano in the Primordial Caves. Throw an Ominous Catalyst into the top of the volcano to wake it.

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.desc: Opens magma-filled cracks under you.

attacks.name: Tail whip
attacks.desc: A flaming tail sweep that sets you on fire.

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.desc: Rains tephra rocks from the sky.

attacks.name: Leap
attacks.desc: Jumps great distances or smashes through blocks to reach you.

Forsaken.find: Created in the Forlorn Hollows when Underzealots perform a ritual on a Vesper.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.desc: Grabs and bites you up close.

attacks.name: Ground smash
attacks.desc: Slams its arms down and launches you.

attacks.name: Slash
attacks.desc: Swipes with an upper arm and knocks you aside.

attacks.name: Sonic blast
attacks.desc: Howls and fires sonic waves into the ground.

Returning Knight.find: Use a Lost Soul on an Old Moon Altar. Using an Essence of Eventide instead summons the harder Fallen Icon (Moonknight).

attacks.name: Obliterate
attacks.desc: Charges his mace, then smashes your old spot; very slow but huge.

attacks.name: Mace of Spades
attacks.desc: A wide swipe followed by a quicker slam.

attacks.name: Blinding Light
attacks.desc: Arm sweep that blinds and slows you.

attacks.name: Eruption
attacks.desc: Slams three times; the third erupts the ground around him.

attacks.name: Children of the Grave
attacks.desc: Summons Remnants and Dark Sorcerers; reflects all projectiles.

Vizier.find: The illagers' high official (Goety). Use a Dark Scroll inside a woodland mansion and it answers.

attacks.name: Spells
attacks.desc: Casts illager spells and summons Irks.

attacks.name: Casting shield
attacks.desc: A shield that halves the damage it takes while it casts.

attacks.name: Sword lunge
attacks.desc: Flies through walls and lunges at you like a vex.

attacks.name: Fang rain
attacks.desc: Floats over you and summons evoker fangs at your feet.

Malkuth.find: Find his arena with an Eye of Malkuth, then right-click the boss spawner there to read his moves and summon him.

attacks.name: Fire and Ice
attacks.desc: His attacks switch between fire and ice; you get weak to one type.

attacks.name: Cannonade
attacks.desc: Jumps on the wall and fires cannons; you can fire your own cannons back.

attacks.name: Earthshatter and Chainpunch
attacks.desc: Leaps and crushes the ground, then punches anyone thrown in the air.

attacks.name: Impaling Doom
attacks.desc: Sends lines of fire or ice spikes.

attacks.name: Tsar's Wrath
attacks.desc: Summons two giant swords that slam down.

sources: jar: fdbosses in-game boss skill descriptions (assets/fdbosses/lang/en_us.json)

Corpse Warlock.find: Rules the Bloody Altar in the Nether.

drops.chance: always (drop is in code, per guide)
always (drop is in code, per guide)

attacks.name: Corpse waves
attacks.desc: Summons corpses in waves and buffs them with Frenzy.

attacks.name: Vampire
attacks.desc: Drains his corpses to heal; kill them first.

attacks.name: Tear Space
attacks.desc: Places spike traps on the ground in your path.

attacks.name: Crimson Rays
attacks.desc: Rains crimson rays down; teleports away when you get close.

Lich.find: The Night Lich is summoned in the Lich Tower in cold biomes by putting a Soul Star in each of four altars. Soul Stars drop from zombies and skeletons and point to the tower.

attacks.name: Exploding orb
attacks.desc: Launches orbs that hit hard and break terrain.

attacks.name: Phantoms
attacks.desc: Summons phantoms to attack you.

attacks.name: Slowing magic
attacks.desc: Can slow you; flies out of melee range, so bring a bow.

Underworld Knight.find: Helvar waits in the Underworld Arena in the Nether; the boss door needs a key found in that dungeon.

attacks.name: Dash thrust
attacks.desc: Dashes across the arena to impale you.

attacks.name: Combo slashes
attacks.desc: Fast sword combos while moving forward.

attacks.name: Aerial slam
attacks.desc: Leaps up and slams down, cracking the floor.

attacks.name: Vulnerable marks
attacks.desc: Hit his marks to knock him down for free damage.

Super Sniffer.find: Strike any Sniffer with lightning (a Lightning Staff works) and it turns into the Super Sniffer.

attacks.name: Uppercut
attacks.desc: Swings its fist up and throws you very high.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.desc: Slams the ground, sometimes after teleporting into the air.

attacks.name: Energy beam
attacks.desc: In phase two fires a long beam that follows you.

attacks.name: Guided Energy Blast
attacks.desc: Below half health fires a huge blast that wrecks the ground.

Gundalf, Circe, Merlin (Shadow Wizards).find: Use an Occult Fabric on the offering pedestal in the middle of a Chthonic Cathedral on the Nether roof. Kill Merlin and Circe close together and they merge into Archmage Gundalf.

Forgotten Guardian.find: Stands in the Catacombs of the Undergarden (in Frostfields and Forgotten Fields). Several can be in one dungeon.

attacks.name: Slow chase
attacks.desc: Stands still until you come near, then follows you.

attacks.name: Heavy melee
attacks.desc: Hits hard up close and deflects some attacks.

Ender Guardian.find: Spawns when you approach the Altar of Void on the third floor of the Ruined Citadel in the End.

attacks.name: Void runes
attacks.desc: Summons void runes under you.

attacks.name: Shulker bullets
attacks.desc: Fires bullets that make you float.

attacks.name: Ender tornado
attacks.desc: Creates a tornado that traps you and explodes.

attacks.name: Ground slam
attacks.desc: After losing its helmet at half health, breaks the floor around it.

Ancient Remnant.find: At the bottom of the Cursed Pyramid in deserts; beat its guards first to wake it.

attacks.name: Sand twisters
attacks.desc: Roars and summons tornadoes that reverse your controls.

attacks.name: Chomp
attacks.desc: A heavy bite.

attacks.name: Tail swipes
attacks.desc: Sweeps its tail around.

attacks.name: Tombstones
attacks.desc: Drops tombstones on you like anvils.

Gauntlet.find: The Nether Gauntlet hides in a rare Gauntlet Arena in the Nether. Break one of the eye blocks on the central pillar with a pickaxe to summon it. Its loot is in a chest after the fight.

attacks.name: Fist charge
attacks.desc: Turns into a fist and rams you; an empowered version explodes and leaves fire.

attacks.name: Red laser
attacks.desc: Charges up and fires a laser that chases you.

attacks.name: Eye window
attacks.desc: Only takes damage while its eye is open, usually after an attack.

Obsidilith.find: Put an Eye of Ender into the Obsidian Altar on the roof of the Obsidilith Arena floating in the End. An Elytra helps. Its loot is in a chest after the fight.

attacks.name: Teleport blasts
attacks.desc: Teleports around the arena and deals big explosive damage.

attacks.name: Rune blocks
attacks.desc: Summons runic blocks that empower it.

Void Blossom.find: Grows in a rare lush cave near the bottom of the Overworld; Void Lilies point the way. The fight starts when you enter.

attacks.name: Thorns
attacks.desc: Spikes rise under your feet or burst outward in a ring.

attacks.name: Spore bomb
attacks.desc: Fires a green spore that explodes and poisons you.

attacks.name: Healing petals
attacks.desc: Places small blossoms that heal it until you break them.

Chesed.find: Find his arena with an Eye of Chesed, then right-click the boss spawner to read his moves and summon him.

attacks.name: Block Barrage
attacks.desc: Tears blocks out of the ground and throws them.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.desc: Slams the floor, sending a shockwave and lightning.

attacks.name: Rolling Thunder
attacks.desc: Rolls around the arena; leaves fire in phase two.

attacks.name: Lightning Ray
attacks.desc: Fires huge rays; break a crystal to become immune.

attacks.name: Tenebrae Aeternae
attacks.desc: Drains his monoliths for a strike that hits everyone.

sources: jar: fdbosses in-game boss skill descriptions (assets/fdbosses/lang/en_us.json)

Moonknight.find: The Fallen Icon: use an Essence of Eventide (from the Frenzied Shade) on an Old Moon Altar. At half health it becomes the Harbinger of Moonlight.

attacks.name: Unbreakable
attacks.desc: On spawn weakens, slows and nauseates players near it.

attacks.name: Obliterate
attacks.desc: A slightly faster version of the knight's mace slam.

attacks.name: Moonfall
attacks.desc: Slams the greatsword down, cracking the ground behind you.

attacks.name: Sword of Light
attacks.desc: Five swings that each shoot a moonlight wave.

attacks.name: Core Beam
attacks.desc: Fires a big beam that sets off explosions.

Accursed Lord.find: The Decaying King lives in the throne room of the Decaying Kingdom in the Nether. Re-fight with a Withered Demon Heart on a Blackstone Pedestal.

attacks.name: Sword Slam
attacks.desc: Slams his blade where you stood.

attacks.name: Fire and Wither Barrage
attacks.desc: Spits fireballs or shadow orbs.

attacks.name: Detonation
attacks.desc: Charges an explosion around himself.

attacks.name: Pull and Spin
attacks.desc: Pulls you in, or spins to knock you far, maybe into lava.

attacks.name: Magma Burst
attacks.desc: Floods the ground around him with lava.

Tyros (fire boss).find: Echo of Tyros: use a Cinderous Soulcaller (cinder essence, netherite scrap, echo shard) at the Cinderous Soul Rune in the Citadel in the Nether.

attacks.name: Melee combos
attacks.desc: Five different fiery sword combos.

attacks.name: Fire spells
attacks.desc: Casts fire magic; your own fire spells do less to him.

attacks.name: Citadel Keepers
attacks.desc: Summons Citadel Keepers to fight with him.

Infernal Dragon.find: Ashlord waits on top of the Dragon Tower in plains and mountains; climb past its guards.

attacks.name: Fire breath
attacks.desc: Breathes fire that leaves burning ground.

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.desc: Stomps with strong knockback, can push you off the tower.

attacks.name: Tail sweep
attacks.desc: Knocks you away.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.desc: A fast bite with long reach.

Redstone Monstrosity.find: Goety's giant golem. A hostile one is a boss; players can also build one with a big mold and an Animation Core.

attacks.name: Smash
attacks.desc: Smashes both fists into the ground for a big shockwave.

attacks.name: Spit
attacks.desc: Spits scatter bombs at you from range.

attacks.name: Summon
attacks.desc: Opens fissures that spawn redstone cubes.

Gob, King of Gnomes.find: Use a Red Gnome Hat on the Golden Gnome Statue in a Court of Gnomes.

attacks.name: Spin slash
attacks.desc: Spins with his sword in a circle.

attacks.name: Ground punch
attacks.desc: Punches the floor for a shockwave.

attacks.name: Jump crush
attacks.desc: Jumps to land on top of you.

attacks.name: Soul fire slash
attacks.desc: Throws a slash that sets you on fire.

attacks.name: Fangs and gnomes
attacks.desc: Summons evoker fangs and Royal Gnomes.

Trial Guardian.find: Put a Spire Key into the padlock at the bottom of a Trial Spire. Leaving the arena despawns it.

attacks.name: Head explosion
attacks.desc: Covers its head, then explodes around itself.

attacks.name: Hex shot
attacks.desc: Snaps its fingers to send a homing hex projectile.

attacks.name: Spinning beams
attacks.desc: Spins with beams shooting from both palms.

attacks.name: Warp slam
attacks.desc: Teleports above you and slams down.

attacks.name: Dungeon Effigies
attacks.desc: Summons helpers, more as its health drops.

Ignis.find: In the Burning Arena in the Nether (Eye of Flame). Beat the Ignited Revenants for Burning Ashes and put them on the Altar of Fire.

attacks.name: Sword swings
attacks.desc: Heavy swings that burn and melt armor.

attacks.name: Shield smash
attacks.desc: Rams or slams his shield, stunning you.

attacks.name: Life steal skewer
attacks.desc: A thrust that heals him.

attacks.name: Fireballs and jumps
attacks.desc: Leaps across the arena throwing fireballs.

attacks.name: Floor breaking
attacks.desc: Breaks the floor, dropping you into lava.

The Harbinger.find: Sleeps in the Ancient Factory underground (Eye of Mech). Give it a Nether Star to wake it.

attacks.name: Wither missiles
attacks.desc: Fires missiles and arcing howitzer shells.

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.desc: Rockets forward, smashing through terrain.

attacks.name: Death Laser
attacks.desc: Sweeps the arena with a laser; hide behind walls.

attacks.name: Half health
attacks.desc: Becomes immune to arrows; EMP blocks stun it.

The Leviathan.find: Put an Abyssal Sacrifice into the Altar of Abyss in the Sunken City (Eye of Abyss). It only takes damage in water.

attacks.name: Tentacle smack
attacks.desc: Whips a tentacle at you.

attacks.name: Masticate
attacks.desc: A brutal bite that stuns.

attacks.name: Tongue pull
attacks.desc: Grabs you with its tongue and drags you in.

attacks.name: Dimensional Tear
attacks.desc: Opens a black hole that pulls you and explodes.

attacks.name: Lasers
attacks.desc: Fires beams and portals around the arena.

Geburah.find: Find its arena with an Eye of Geburah, then right-click the boss spawner to read its moves and summon it.

attacks.name: Ray of Purification
attacks.desc: Charges and fires a huge ray from its core.

attacks.name: Rays of Justice
attacks.desc: Rotates constant lasers around the arena.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.desc: Stomps to send a shockwave.

attacks.name: Sins
attacks.desc: Bans an action (jumping, standing still, killing...); breaking the rule builds up sin.

attacks.name: Divine Judgement
attacks.desc: Balance the scales by hitting bells or take a huge hit.

sources: jar: fdbosses in-game boss skill descriptions (assets/fdbosses/lang/en_us.json)

Nameless Guardian.find: Since EEEAB's Mobs 0.98 it no longer spawns in normal survival (only eggs or commands). It used to guard the Coreforge Ruins.

attacks.name: Shield breaker
attacks.desc: Melee hits that stop you using a shield.

attacks.name: Life drain
attacks.desc: All its attacks heal it.

attacks.name: Powered state
attacks.desc: Below 60% health it hits harder and ignores projectiles.

attacks.name: Core weak point
attacks.desc: Only the glowing core inside the body takes real damage.

Realm Warden.find: The Realmwarden guards the portal in the Coreforge Ruins underground (Eye of Coreforge Ruins).

attacks.name: Ground pound
attacks.desc: Big area hit in the middle of the room; hug the walls.

attacks.name: Swings and sweeps
attacks.desc: Heavy swings, elbows, stomps and wide sweeps.

attacks.name: Backstep missiles
attacks.desc: Jumps back while firing a missile volley.

attacks.name: Overload
attacks.desc: In phase two its hits make fire explode on you.

Relic Annihilator.find: A Relicron construct in the Coreforge Ruins underground (Eye of Coreforge Ruins).

attacks.name: Missiles
attacks.desc: Fires missiles at you.

attacks.name: Saw blades
attacks.desc: Spinning saw blades up close; very fast on its wheels.

attacks.name: Exposed core
attacks.desc: Its head core opens while firing missiles or lasers; hit it then.

Day Stalker.find: Throw a Chaos Orb into the sky to summon both Day Stalker and Night Prowler. The survivor enrages when one dies. She is stronger in daytime.

attacks.name: Decimate
attacks.desc: Drags Dawnbreaker along the ground and launches you up.

attacks.name: Chaos Storm
attacks.desc: Summons flame pillars around herself.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.desc: Sprays a stream of fire.

attacks.name: Sunfire Rush
attacks.desc: Five swings that shoot sunlight waves.

attacks.name: Sky High
attacks.desc: Flies high and crashes down in a huge explosion.

Night Prowler.find: Summoned together with the Day Stalker by throwing a Chaos Orb into the sky. She is stronger at night.

attacks.name: Trinity
attacks.desc: Hurls her scythe into the ground for an explosion.

attacks.name: Ripple Fang
attacks.desc: Rings of evoker fangs spread out from her.

attacks.name: Blackflame Snake
attacks.desc: Sends a homing snake of black fire.

attacks.name: Darkness Rise
attacks.desc: An aura that decays everyone near.

attacks.name: Eclipse
attacks.desc: Phase two ultimate that blasts everything around with dark skulls.

The Obliterator.find: Insert an Eye Crystal into the Teleport Machine in the Space Station in the End highlands, midlands or small islands.

attacks.name: Laser barrages
attacks.desc: Fires four-beam laser barrages.

attacks.name: Teleport combos
attacks.desc: Teleports and chains attacks; bait a move, hit, then reset.

Apostle.find: Summoned by the Sabbath Ritual at a Goety dark altar (ritual in the Nether for the strongest drops).

attacks.name: Arrows
attacks.desc: Shoots arrows, faster as its health drops.

attacks.name: Fireballs
attacks.desc: Throws ghast-like fireballs (unblockable on hard).

attacks.name: Obsidian Monoliths
attacks.desc: Summons monoliths that protect it and call servants.

attacks.name: Second phase
attacks.desc: Heals to full, brings a storm, meteors and lightning traps.

Ferrous Wroughtnaut.find: Stands in the Wrought Chamber, an underground room found in almost every biome.

attacks.name: Axe swing
attacks.desc: Huge axe swing that breaks shields; chains into double and triple swings later.

attacks.name: Overhead slam
attacks.desc: Gets its axe stuck; the only time you can hit it, from behind.

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.desc: Stomps to throw blocks up; jump to dodge.

Maledictus.find: Bottom chamber of the Frosted Prison in snowy biomes. Beat the Aptrgangr for the Strange Key, open the Door of Seal and right-click the Cursed Tombstone.

attacks.name: Colour warnings
attacks.desc: Wrist rings show the attack: green can be blocked, orange breaks shields, red must be dodged.

attacks.name: Rupturing Descent
attacks.desc: Slam that sends shockwaves out.

attacks.name: Warrior's Lunge
attacks.desc: Halberd dash that hits many times.

attacks.name: Thousand Pierced Fall
attacks.desc: Rains spectral halberds over a wide area.

attacks.name: Phantom Bow
attacks.desc: Shoots you when you stay at range.

Scylla.find: At the top of the Acropolis in deep oceans (Eye of Storm). Right-click the giant anchor to summon her.

attacks.name: Anchor
attacks.desc: Swings and throws her anchor to pull you in.

attacks.name: Waves
attacks.desc: Sends waves that make you Wet; wet players take more shock damage.

attacks.name: Lightning spears
attacks.desc: Throws lightning spears that ignore armor.

attacks.name: Storm and serpents
attacks.desc: Later summons storm spears and magic serpents.

Immortal.find: The quest book gives a summon command as its reward.

attacks.name: Damage adaptation
attacks.desc: Adapts to damage types you repeat; switch types.

attacks.name: Two phases
attacks.desc: Has two health bars and resets adaptation between them.

Chaos Monarch.find: Use a Shard of Uncertainty (dropped by the Wither) on a Blackstone Pedestal.

attacks.name: Cripple
attacks.desc: Staff combo of swipe, thrust and smash.

attacks.name: Chaos Skulls
attacks.desc: Skulls with random effects, explosions or mobs.

attacks.name: Lightning Call
attacks.desc: Lightning spreading outward three times.

attacks.name: Barrage
attacks.desc: Shoots piles of random projectiles.

attacks.name: Withered ground
attacks.desc: Turns grass to withered grass that decays you and heals it.

The Nightwarden.find: Found only in the Void Cathedral, a rare structure in the End.

attacks.name: Many telegraphed attacks
attacks.desc: Three phases with a dozen telegraphed spell and melee patterns.

attacks.name: Damage adaptation
attacks.desc: Resists damage you repeat; vary your attacks.

attacks.name: Counterspell windows
attacks.desc: Interrupting his casts gives openings.

Virtue.find: Throw an Unholy Lance into the sky anywhere in the Overworld. Stays very high in the air, so bring guns or bows.

attacks.name: Light pillars
attacks.desc: Creates pillars of light that hurt over time.

attacks.name: Vulnerability
attacks.desc: Its pillars make you take more damage.

Ultra Sniffer.find: In the Super Sniffer's second phase, strike it with lightning again while it is under 10% health.

attacks.name: Energy beam
attacks.desc: Fires a long beam that follows you.

attacks.name: Uppercut and slam
attacks.desc: Throws you very high and slams the ground.

attacks.name: Warp strikes
attacks.desc: In phase two warps around leaving traces that become strikes.

attacks.name: Kamehameha
attacks.desc: Below half health fires a faster, longer super beam.

Lord Pumpkinhead.find: Use a Transmuting Elixir on an Infernal Evil Pumpkin.

attacks.name: Cursed strikes
attacks.desc: Mounted hits that cause Soul Stratification and Infernal Flame; later Living Bomb.

attacks.name: Teleport and bombs
attacks.desc: Teleports, leaving Senior Pumpkins or pumpkin bombs behind.

attacks.name: Pumpkin pistol
attacks.desc: Dismounts and shoots; his horse fights up close.

attacks.name: Headless
attacks.desc: In the last stage his head shoots while his body fights.

Minister.find: Leads illager raids (Goety). Outranks every Evoker, rallies the other raiders and blocks with its staff.

attacks.name: Rally
attacks.desc: Buffs and rallies the other illagers of the raid.

attacks.name: Staff block
attacks.desc: Blocks incoming hits with its staff.

Minister.drops_note: Ominous Orb, or shards of it (quest book); emeralds from its loot table

Crone.find: Use the Crystal Ball inside a Blighted Shack (swamps) to call her (Goety).

attacks.name: Brews
attacks.desc: Throws witch brews far nastier than a normal witch's.

attacks.name: Thorns
attacks.desc: Hitting her hurts you back.

Crone.drops_note: Crone Hat, the best witch hat in Goety (quest book); brewing ingredients from its loot table

Heresiarch.find: The priest at the obsidian monolith of a Black Assembly (Goety cult structure).

attacks.name: Cult leader
attacks.desc: Fights beside the chanting cultists of the Black Assembly.

Heresiarch.drops_note: Malefic Helm: cultists, witches and warlocks stay neutral to you (quest book)

Skull Lord.find: Old ruler of a Goety Crypt (under forest, taiga and plains), woken by opening a jar in the grand tomb. The floating skull is the real body; the Bone Lord is its armour.

attacks.name: Bone Lord
attacks.desc: Fights inside its Bone Lord armour; the floating skull is the part to kill.

Skull Lord.drops_note: Carries the Frozen Blade and the Cursed Paladin set (quest book)

Wither Necromancer.find: Blow a Blazing Horn inside a Nether Fortress; it answers with wither skeletons at its side (Goety).

attacks.name: Wither skeletons
attacks.desc: Summons wither skeletons to fight beside it.

Brood Mother.find: The giant spider of a Goety Spider Den (hollowed giant trees in the woods, on top of an old mine).

attacks.name: Venom
attacks.desc: Its poison works even on undead.

attacks.name: Brood
attacks.desc: Spawns its children to join the fight.

Brood Mother.drops_note: Spider fangs for Revelation's spider armour (quest book)

Wight.find: A Sabbath ritual with four crypt stones and ectoplasm on the altar calls it up (Goety).

attacks.name: Shadow realm
attacks.desc: A shadow boss raised by the Sabbath ritual.

Wight.drops_note: Essence of Shadow makes Dark Alloy four times cheaper (quest book)

Ender Keeper.find: Put four Void Shards in the shrine on top of the Final Terminal, a Goety structure in the End highlands guarded by Enderlings.

attacks.name: Pull and blast
attacks.desc: Pulls things in, then explodes. Stay mobile.

Ender Keeper.drops_note: Void Echoes and the Shrouded Blueprint for the Redstone Monstrosity (quest book)

Ice Hermit.find: Waits in the middle of the Frostyard, a frozen court sunk into snowy plains, ice spikes, snowy taiga and groves (Goety: Revelation, new in 6.6.6).

attacks.name: Frost meter
attacks.desc: Its ice fills a frost meter on you; a full meter freezes you solid. Frost robes halve what it adds.

attacks.name: Ice pillar ritual
attacks.desc: At half health it turns untouchable and starts a 30 second ritual fed by four ice pillars. Break them all or it heals back to three quarters.

attacks.name: Absolute Zero
attacks.desc: Below a quarter health it opens a 60 block domain of ice beams worth 20 damage each.

Ice Hermit.drops_note: Two Hearts of Silent Frost: they make the Cryogenic Core, the Absolute Zero Focus and, through the core, the Frostbloom staff. No single hit on it deals more than 20; weak to fire and blunt, resists frost and arcane (quest book)
Ice Hermit.src_note: Linggango quest book, Goety: World chapter (6.6.6)
